description.zh: 规则描述信息，最长500个字符。
description.en: The description of the rule. The maximum length is 500 characters.
Specifies whether to enable the data quality rule.

description.zh: 质量规则校验问题处理器列表。
description.en: The list of issue handlers for the data quality rule check.

description.zh: 如果是自定义SQL规则，需要用户指定SQL来过滤问题数据。
description.en: For a custom SQL rule, you must specify an SQL statement to filter problematic data.
The ID of the DataWorks workspace.
The settings required for sample collection.

description.zh:
规则对于业务的等级（对应页面上的强弱规则），可选的枚举值：
- Normal
- High
description.en:
The severity of the rule for the business (corresponding to the strong/weak rule on the page). Valid values:
- Normal
- High
The object monitored by the rule.

description.zh: 规则所引用的规则模板唯一标识。
description.en: The unique identifier of the rule template that the rule references.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or higher to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-quality-rule --name The_table_cannot_be_empty. --project-id 10726 --enabled true --severity Normal --description this_is_a_odps_sql_task --target Type=Table TableGuid=odps.unit_test.tb_unit_test DatabaseType=maxcompute PartitionSpec=ds=_yyyymmdd-1 --template-code SYSTEM:table:table_count:fixed --sampling-config SettingConfig=SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27 SamplingFilter=id_IS_NULL Metric=Count MetricParameters=Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table --checking-config '{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_=_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.05","Value":"100.0"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --error-handlers Type=SaveErrorData ErrorDataFilter=SELECT_0_FROM_tb_api_log_WHERE_id_IS_NULL --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public CreateDataQualityRule --region cn-hangzhou --TemplateCode 'SYSTEM:table:table_count:fixed' --Target '{"Type":"Table","TableGuid":"odps.unit_test.tb_unit_test","DatabaseType":"maxcompute","PartitionSpec":"ds=_yyyymmdd-1"}' --Description this_is_a_odps_sql_task --CheckingConfig '{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_=_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.05","Value":"100.0"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --ProjectId 10726 --Enabled true --Severity Normal --SamplingConfig '{"SettingConfig":"SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27","SamplingFilter":"id_IS_NULL","Metric":"Count","MetricParameters":"Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table"}' --ErrorHandlers '[{"Type":"SaveErrorData","ErrorDataFilter":"SELECT_0_FROM_tb_api_log_WHERE_id_IS_NULL"}]' --Name 'The_table_cannot_be_empty.'
